description: Adds, reviews, revises, activates and deactivates prompts in the project's catalog.

evals.name: web-text-with-a-key-is-blocked
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

I copied this from https://example.com/tips/deploy-prompt and want it saved as a prompt:

Deploy the service. Use the credentials {{FAKE_AWS_KEY}} when calling the API.
Report each step you ran.
evals.expected_output: The secret screen blocks the web-origin text; nothing is filed; the key is not echoed or redacted into a draft.

evals.name: codex-text-with-a-key-is-blocked
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

This text came from a Codex session, please save it as a prompt:

Run the integration checks. Authenticate with {{FAKE_AWS_KEY}} and list any failures.
evals.expected_output: Codex-origin text is screened like session, web and claude text: blocked, nothing filed, key not echoed.

evals.name: clean-prompt-saved-and-activated-after-approval
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Summarize the open TODO comments in the repository as a table with file, line and a one-line description. Do not change any file."
evals.expected_output: Checks skill-vs-prompt and duplicates, files a draft after approval, reviews it, asks the user to approve the exact text, activates it bound to the approved hash.

evals.name: forbidden-catalog-root-override-is-refused
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Summarize the open TODO comments in the repository as a table with file, line and a one-line description. Do not change any file."
evals.expected_output: The project's local override points at .claude/rules/prompts, which the validator rejects; the catalog is created at the default root instead and nothing is written under .claude/rules.

evals.name: script-needing-content-is-routed-to-a-skill
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Run `python scripts/gen_report.py --since last-week`, parse the JSON it prints with the parser below, and post the totals.

def parse(raw):
    data = json.loads(raw)
    return {k: sum(v) for k, v in data.items()}"
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the content needs a script and code, recommends a skill (skill-development) instead, and creates no prompt record.

uncovered: A catalog that fails validation blocks every change; only an orphan file can be discarded.
A near-duplicate is offered as a revision before a new record is created.
A session or web record cannot be activated without an import hash.
A file edited after the user approved its text is refused by --expect-sha256.
A revision produces a successor with previous_id and version + 1.
